correctness.rationale: Every allowed full-pair prefix has precisely A−1 next choices, while every column b remains extendible after removing one pair since ℓ_b≥2. Hence exact symbolic k-scale count is (A−1)^θ B^{k−θ}, θ=floor(k log m/log n). Cells have comparable sides m^{-k}, and bounded overlap gives both box dimensions. For packing dimension every relatively open subset contains a cylinder image of full upper box dimension s; Baire plus countable-cover characterization yields packing≥s. The external 2026 Hausdorff formula is E sum_b L_b^λ / log m; Jensen equality requires constant L_b at every root label with positive probability, forcing a unique forbidden column and ℓ_J−1=ℓ_b for b≠J. Independently tested eight constructed finite column-tree environments and concavity boundaries; finite checks do not prove unbounded depth or the external Hausdorff identity.
residual_risks: All columns require ℓ_b≥2; symbolic rectangles may share boundaries but box-cover comparisons are bounded multiplicity. Hausdorff comparison depends on the actual independent-label source theorem, not a newly proved environmentwise Hausdorff formula.
